findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "lookup_service_address" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_referral_options · Private data: get_referral_options, lookup_service_address, prepare_referral_request, submit_referral_request · Public sink: get_referral_options, submit_referral_request.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
